title: Card and Krueger (1994) New Jersey-Pennsylvania fast-food survey
notes: 410 fast-food stores surveyed just before (wave 1, Feb-Mar 1992) and about 8 months after (wave 2, Nov-Dec 1992) New Jersey's minimum-wage increase; Pennsylvania stores are the comparison group. From the public njmin.zip archive (public.dat + codebook); no licence restriction stated. Column dictionary in data-raw/variables/labour.csv, built from the zip's codebook.

title: Angrist and Lavy (1999) Israel class size (Maimonides' rule)
notes: 4th and 5th grade classes (final4.dta/final5.dta stacked, grade column) in Israeli public schools, c. 1991, used to instrument class size with Maimonides' rule (max 40 pupils per class). Column dictionary (partial, main variables) in data-raw/variables/labour.csv; town names are in Hebrew and may not render in all locales.

title: Angrist (1990) Vietnam draft lottery, FICA earnings cells 1964-1977
notes: Grouped Social Security (Continuous Work History Sample) earnings cells by birth cohort (1944-1953), race, draft-lottery-number interval (73 bins of 5 numbers) and calendar year 1964-1977; mean/sd/n of FICA-taxable earnings per cell (cwhsa.dta). Column names as in the source file; see [a1990_b] for the 1978-1984 extension.

title: Angrist (1990) Vietnam draft lottery, FICA and W-2 earnings cells 1978-1984
notes: Same cell structure as [a1990_a] (birth cohort x race x lottery interval x year) for 1978-1984, with both FICA-taxable and total W-2 compensation (type column, cwhsb.dta).

title: Abadie, Angrist and Imbens (2002) JTPA training experiment
notes: 11,204 JTPA (Job Training Partnership Act) applicants with random assignment to training (jtpa.raw), 30-month earnings and covariates; used for the paper's quantile treatment effect estimates. Column meanings recovered from the comments in the archive's qeffectsfinal.m; hsorged/married/wkless13 are hot-deck-imputed and may be fractional.

title: Angrist and Lavy (2009) high school achievement awards RCT
notes: Individual-level panel of Israeli high school students in schools randomized into an achievement-award program, cohorts 2000-2002 (base00/01/02.dta stacked; the pre-experiment base99 baseline cohort is not included). Official codebook reproduced in data-raw/variables/labour.csv; student/school ids are fictitious and not consistent across the archive's Stata and SAS files.

title: Angrist, Lang and Oreopoulos (2009) Canadian STAR incentives RCT
notes: 1,656 first-year students at a Canadian university randomized into support-services and/or grade-incentive (STAR) treatments; grades, credits, and survey responses (STAR_public_use.dta). Column dictionary from the archive's readme.txt.

title: Angrist, Bettinger and Kremer (2006) Colombia voucher long-run follow-up
notes: 4,044 PACES voucher-lottery applicants matched (by id/name/city) to their national ICFES exam records 5-8 years after the lottery, with math and reading scores (aerdata_colombia2.dta). Companion long-run file to [abbkk2002].

title: Angrist, Bettinger, Bloom, King and Kremer (2002) Colombia PACES voucher lottery
notes: Bogota (1995, 1997) and Jamundi (1993) PACES voucher-lottery survey respondents (1,618 of the 25,330 applicants in the full aerdat4.sas7bdat, filtered to BOG95SMP/BOG97SMP/JAM93SMP==1 and 27 of its 89 columns to stay under the package's per-object size budget); demographics, grade repetition and progression, and labour-market outcomes. Full file kept at data-raw/abbkk2002/ for anyone who needs the other columns.

title: Autor, Dorn and Hanson (2013) China trade shock, commuting zones
notes: 722 US commuting zones x 2 periods (1990-2000, 2000-2007); start-of-period levels (l_ prefix) and 10-year-equivalent changes (d_ prefix) in manufacturing employment, wages and Chinese import exposure per worker, plus the Autor-Dorn-Hanson instrument. Subset of 31 of the 208 columns in workfile_china.dta (main-table variables only) to fit the package's size budget; cite the paper per the data page's access policy.

title: Duflo (2001) Indonesia INPRES school construction, regency-level variables
notes: 308 birth regencies: number of INPRES primary schools built 1973-1978, 1971 child population/enrollment/density, program-intensity instruments and the Java/poor indicators used in the paper's Table 6. From David Roodman's replication repository (MIT licence); the underlying 1995 SUPAS/SUSENAS micro files are not redistributable and are not included.
